meta.title: AddressPast · New Mexico property history
meta.description: Free check for reported deaths and other public records at or near any New Mexico address. Sourced, calm, and transparent.

search.label: Address or question
search.placeholder: Enter a New Mexico address, or ask a question
search.locateDenied: Location access was blocked. You can type an address instead.
search.voiceUnsupported: Voice search isn't supported in this browser.
search.noResults: No New Mexico matches. Try adding the city, or tap the map.

search.askHint: Press Enter to search this as a question

check.heading: Free check
check.noneTitle: No reported deaths found at or near this address in our records.
check.noneTitleOther: No records found at or near this address in our sources.
check.atAddress: {count, plural, =1 {# record at this address} other {# records at this address}}
check.searched: We searched {sources, plural, =1 {# source} other {# sources}} covering {from}–{to} for {county} County, as of {date}.
check.gapNote: Newspaper coverage from 1964–2010 is thin, so missing records don't mean nothing happened.
check.naturalHidden: {count, plural, =1 {# natural-cause record} other {# natural-cause records}} hidden.
check.cityOnly: {count, plural, =1 {# {city} record has} other {# {city} records have}} only a city-level location, so we can't place {count, plural, =1 {it} other {them}} on a street.
check.parcel: Matched to the county parcel for this lot.
check.builtIn: The building on this lot was built in {year}.
check.olderThanBuilding: {count, plural, =1 {# record here is older than it and may refer to an earlier building on the lot.} other {# records here are older than it and may refer to an earlier building on the lot.}}
check.townHeading: {count, plural, =1 {# record} other {# records}} placed only in {city} (exact spot unknown)
check.townFailed: Couldn't load those records. Try again in a moment.

record.verifiedHelp: A person on our team checked this record against its source.
record.locked: The summary and source links come with the full property report.
record.reportError: Report an error or request removal
record.buildingLevelHelp: This happened in an apartment or unit in this building. We never show which unit.
record.predatesHelp: The building on this lot was built in {built}. This record is from {year}, so it may refer to an earlier building.

filters.title: Filter records
filters.naturalNote: Off by default. Most natural deaths aren't what people are worried about, and they're the most sensitive for families.

disclaimer: Records come from public news and archives. They may be incomplete or wrong, and this is not a legal disclosure.

waitlist.headline: Know what happened here before you move in.
waitlist.body: AddressPast checks public newspaper archives and records for reported deaths and other history at any New Mexico address. It's free to check, every record shows its sources, and the tone stays calm.

points.free: Free basic check for every address
points.sources: Sources and confidence on every record
points.map: A map of the whole neighborhood, back to the 1860s

waitlist.ok: You're on the list. We'll email you when we launch.
waitlist.exists: You're already on the list. Thanks!
waitlist.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
waitlist.privacy: We'll only email you about the launch. No spam, no sharing.

area.title: Property history in {area}, New Mexico
area.description: Aggregate public records for {area}: reported deaths by decade and category, with sources and coverage notes.
area.aggregateNote: This page shows totals only. To check a specific address, use the free check.
area.aiNote: Overview written by AI from the totals above. It never sees individual records.
area.naturalExcluded: Natural-cause deaths are excluded from these totals.

footer.pilot: Pilot: Bernalillo and Valencia counties, New Mexico.
footer.rights: Historic newspaper scans courtesy of the Library of Congress, Chronicling America.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many searches in a short time. Please wait a minute.
errors.geocoder: Address lookup is having trouble. Try again, or tap the map.

removal.open: Report an error or request removal
removal.title: Report an error or request removal
removal.intro: Tell us what's wrong. If this record is about someone close to you and it's from the last 10 years, we hide it right away while we review.
removal.done: Thanks. A person will review your request, usually within a few days.
removal.doneFast: Thanks. We've hidden this record while we review your request. It can take a few minutes to disappear everywhere.
removal.error: We couldn't send that. Please try again in a few minutes.
removal.privacy: We use your email only to follow up on this request.
